chamfer 0.6 x 45 deg ; end relief O1.4
Board: PRE-COLOURED lemon #feed95, 400 g/m2, caliper 0.50 mm (or 350 g / 0.44 mm for a digital press: slot 0.60). No flood print, no bleed.
Digital presses mostly stop at 300-350 g: check; 400 g duplex = litho / screen / flat-bed digital.
Slot 0.70 net = board + 0.20. A slot depth 11.0; B floor 10.4 -> 0.6 mm bottoming gap (> die / laser tolerance 0.2). Play angle 1.0 deg.
STEEL RULE: a single rule only slits (fibre springback leaves ~0.35-0.55): ask the die-maker for
(a) 3 pt (1.07) blunt slot rule or (b) two 2 pt rules at 0.70 clear gap with stripping pin; first article decides.
LASER: draw 0.50 (kerf 0.20 -> 0.70 net); edge scorch is visible on lemon -> use a 2nd pass at low power or tumble.
KNIFE PLOTTER: not suitable for a 0.7 slot (sliver stays in); use laser or die.
Slot test strip: 0.60 / 0.70 / 0.80 / 0.90 on every sheet (see imposition) - pick the fit with the real board.
Name: Wix Madefor Text Medium 7.2 mm, baseline z 27 (cap top 32.1), ABOVE B (max 26.4). Table/seat one line 4.9 mm = 3.5 mm caps, on A.
Footprint 100 x 64 mm (rhombus), height 45. Flat A 100x45, B 64x26.4 fit C6 / DL.
No creases: both plates are flat.
